tools.name: calculate_net_pay
tools.description: Gross-to-net payroll: take-home pay, income tax and statutory contributions for a salary in a supported country (us, ph, ng, id, in, br, ke, vn, mx, za, tr, co, pk, eg, cl, pe, bd, ar, gh, sa, ae, th, my, ma, pl, pt, ro, es, kz, uz, lk, np, ec, cr, do). Returns a breakdown, rule version and official

tools.name: calculate_employer_cost
tools.description: Total cost of employing someone: gross salary plus employer social security, health, pension and mandatory accruals (13th month etc.) in a supported country. Returns items, total cost, cost multiplier and sources.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: List supported countries with currency, tax year, rule version, scope and sources.
